metadata.datasource: Kodak publication F-4016 (October 2007, the T-MAX films), P3200 section: vector paths of p25 (spectral sensitivity), p26 (T-MAX Developer small-tank characteristic curves, 6/9/11/13 min) and p27 (contrast index vs time). The later F-4001 (March 2018) prints T-MAX 100's characteristic and spectral charts in their place (identical paths to F-4016's T-MAX 100 page; speed point ISO ~100); F-4001 (April 2019) restores P3200's (raster), which agree with F-4016's.

tags.log_sensitivity: SHEET 420-700 nm: the 0.3 greater than D-min curve (the upper one); ASSUMED held below 420 nm, ASSUMED log-linear tail -0.0557 dex/nm above 700 nm; scale MEASURED so grey 0.184 -> raw 1
tags.density_curves: SHEET for log_exposure -1.68..2.15 (T-MAX Developer small tank, 20 C, to contrast index 0.56 (time read off the sheet's own T-MAX contrast-index line) at the nominal speed EI 1000 that Kodak gives for T-MAX Developer: 7.51 min, interpolated between the plotted 6 and 9 min curves; slope 0.3-1.5 over base+fog 0.518); ASSUMED flat toe below, ASSUMED straight line slope 0.427 into a ceiling of gross D 3.0 above
tags.channel_density: ASSUMED: neutral silver, 1/3 per channel at every wavelength
tags.density_curves_layers: ASSUMED: three-CDF fit of the curve (max fit error 0.0110 D), no sheet data on emulsion sub-layers
